responsibility: Defines channel-based text I/O for characters and fixed CHAR arrays in the gm2 ISO library. It specifies bounded line-sensitive input operations for single characters, remainder-of-line strings, line-limited strings, tokens, and line skipping, along with character, line-mark, and string output procedures, all operating on IOChan channels and reporting read completion through the shared IOConsts.ReadResults conventions.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the API contract for channel-based text I/O, declaring the available read and write procedures and their ReadResults behavior; the same-stem .mod file contains the actual channel operations and buffering logic.
